title: Uncollapsed Panel Styling Bug
description: ui: There is a bug when clicking on e.g. the left window panel then when it uncollapses the toggle is cut and has wrong styling.
summary: Prevented overflowing panel tab rows from reserving horizontal scrollbar height: the shared panel/mobile tab strip now hides its native scrollbar while retaining horizontal scrolling, so fixed-height rows keep every tab as a full-height control. Extended the existing React and styling tests with the component/CSS invariant.
